bank.module: Session 9 — Reusable SQL Logic: Views & Functions
bank.title: Session 9 — SQL Functions & Stored Procedures — Bank 002

questions.question: What does a scalar SQL function do according to Session 9?

options.text: It operates on a single value and returns a single value.
It can only be used inside a stored procedure.

explanation.ar: الـ Scalar Function بتاخد قيمة واحدة وتطلع قيمة واحدة، زي UPPER(name).

questions.question: Which function is used in the lecture to convert employee names to uppercase?

explanation.ar: مثال الـ Scalar Functions في Slide 13 هو SELECT UPPER(name) FROM employees;.

questions.question: Which function example counts the total number of orders?

explanation.ar: Slide 14 تستخدم SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders; لحساب إجمالي عدد الطلبات.

questions.question: What is ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) intended to do in the lecture example?

options.text: Round every salary to the nearest hundred.
Calculate average salary and round the result to two decimal places.

explanation.ar: AVG بتحسب المتوسط وROUND(..., 2) بتقرب الناتج لرقمين عشريين.

questions.question: Which function is used to combine first_name and last_name into one full-name value in Session 9?

explanation.ar: Slide 16 تستخدم CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) لإنشاء full name.

questions.question: What is a stored procedure according to Session 9?

options.text: A set of SQL statements stored and executed on the database server.
A view that cannot accept parameters.
A database index that stores only keys.

explanation.ar: الـ Stored Procedure هي مجموعة SQL statements محفوظة وتتنفذ على database server.

source.reference: Slide 23 — What is a Stored Procedure?

questions.question: Which capability of stored procedures is explicitly listed in Session 9?

options.text: They must execute only on the client.
They can accept information in the form of parameters.
They replace every table with a view.

explanation.ar: المادة بتذكر إن Stored Procedures تقبل parameters وترجع results للـ client.

source.reference: Slide 23 — What is a Stored Procedure?

questions.question: Which is listed as a benefit of stored procedures?

explanation.ar: من المزايا المذكورة: reduction in network traffic، performance، reuse of code، وزيادة security.

questions.question: What does an input parameter such as @DepartmentID let a stored procedure do?

options.text: Receive a value that can be used inside the procedure's SQL logic.
Create a view for every row.

explanation.ar: الـ input parameter بيمرر قيمة للـ procedure عشان تستخدمها في الاستعلام، زي DepartmentID في مثال Slide 26.

source.reference: Slide 26 — How to Use This Procedure

questions.question: What does SELECT CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) FROM employees; return?

options.text: A combined full-name value for each employee row.
The average length of all names.
Only employees whose names are uppercase.

explanation.ar: CONCAT بيجمع النصوص المحددة لكل row، وهنا بيرجع first_name + space + last_name.

questions.question: What is the output purpose of SELECT DAY(RESCUEDATE) FROM PETRESCUE WHERE ANIMAL='Cat';?

options.text: Return the full date plus one day.
Return the day-of-month portion of RESCUEDATE for rows where ANIMAL is Cat.

explanation.ar: DAY() في المثال بتستخرج جزء اليوم من التاريخ بعد فلترة الصفوف اللي ANIMAL='Cat'.

questions.question: What does DATE_ADD(RESCUEDATE, INTERVAL 3 DAY) compute in the lecture?

options.text: The number of days since RESCUEDATE.
A date three years before RESCUEDATE.
A date three days after each RESCUEDATE.

explanation.ar: DATE_ADD مع INTERVAL 3 DAY تضيف 3 أيام على RESCUEDATE.

questions.question: Which special registers are shown in Session 9 for obtaining current date/time information?

explanation.ar: Slide 22 تعرض CURRENT_DATE وCURRENT_TIME كـ special registers.

questions.question: A dashboard needs customer tenure based on a stored JoinDate and the current date. Which taught family of logic is most relevant?

options.text: Date/time functions and date arithmetic such as DATEDIFF with the current date.

explanation.ar: الـ Assignment نفسه يطلب date calculations for customer tenure، والمادة تعرض DATEDIFF وCURRENT_DATE ضمن Date/Time Arithmetic.

questions.question: Which classification best fits COUNT(*) in Session 9?

explanation.ar: COUNT(*) بيحسب نتيجة واحدة من multiple rows، لذلك هو Aggregate Function.

questions.question: Which classification best fits ROUND() in the Session 9 function categories?

explanation.ar: Slide 12 تصنف Mathematical Functions كفئة، وSlide 15 تستخدم ROUND() كمثال مباشر.

questions.question: A query returns customer segments using CASE inside a view. What role does CASE play?

options.text: It returns a conditional value based on the first matching condition.
It creates a stored procedure automatically.
It permanently groups rows into new tables.
It replaces the view with an index.

explanation.ar: CASE expression بتختار قيمة output حسب الشروط، زي VIP/Premium/Standard/Basic في الـ View.

questions.question: A procedure GetEmployeesInDepartment receives @DepartmentID = 101 and uses WHERE DepartmentID = @DepartmentID. What is the parameter doing?

options.text: Filtering the procedure's query to DepartmentID 101.

explanation.ar: القيمة 101 بتدخل للـ parameter ثم WHERE تستخدمها لفلترة الموظفين على نفس DepartmentID.

source.reference: Slide 26 — How to Use This Procedure

questions.question: A caller wants to run GetEmployeesInDepartment for department 101. Which invocation matches the Session 9 example?

explanation.ar: Slide 26 تعرض EXEC كطريقة تشغيل الـ Stored Procedure مع parameter.

source.reference: Slide 26 — How to Use This Procedure

questions.question: A company repeatedly sends the same multi-statement business logic from an application to the database. Which Session 9 feature is the best candidate for reuse on the server?

options.text: A new physical database for each request

explanation.ar: ده external-similar مبني على benefits الـ Stored Procedures: reuse of code وتقليل network traffic لأن logic محفوظ وينفذ على السيرفر.

questions.question: Why can stored procedures reduce network traffic according to the lecture?

options.text: Reusable SQL logic runs on the database server instead of repeatedly sending all statements from the client.
Because procedures prevent all client connections.
Because they convert queries into images.

explanation.ar: منطق الـ procedure محفوظ على server، فالـ client يرسل call/parameters بدل إرسال نفس مجموعة statements كل مرة، وده يفسر تقليل network traffic.

questions.question: The procedure UPDATE_SAL receives empNum and rating. If rating = 1, what does the shown example indicate?

options.text: The first UPDATE branch increases the employee's salary by 10%.
The procedure creates a view instead.

explanation.ar: المثال في Slides 25–26 يوضح إن rating = 1 ينفذ UPDATE salary = salary * 1.10 للموظف المحدد.

questions.question: If the same UPDATE_SAL procedure is called with a rating other than 1, what does the shown logic do?

options.text: It always applies both 10% and 5% increases.
It uses the second UPDATE branch that multiplies salary by 1.05.

explanation.ar: الكود الظاهر فيه branch تاني بشرط rating <> 1 لزيادة 5%، وبالتالي مش المفروض ينفذ branch الـ 10% في نفس الحالة.

questions.question: A report needs total orders, total amount spent, cleaned customer names, and customer tenure. Which combination best matches the Session 9 assignment?

options.text: Aggregate functions + string functions + date calculations, optionally exposed through a view.

explanation.ar: الـ Assignment يطلب total orders/amount، formatting، CASE، وdate calculations؛ يعني استخدام aggregate + string + date functions داخل reporting query/view.

questions.question: What is the main difference between scalar and aggregate functions in the Session 9 classification?

options.text: Scalar functions operate on a single value; aggregate functions compute a result from multiple rows.
Scalar functions can only be used in views; aggregates only in procedures.
Aggregate functions always return text; scalar functions always return dates.
There is no difference in the lecture.

explanation.ar: الفرق الأساسي المذكور في Slide 12 هو نطاق العمل: scalar على single value، aggregate على multiple rows.

questions.question: If AVG(salary) returns 5432.6789, what would ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) produce conceptually?

explanation.ar: ROUND(..., 2) يقرب النتيجة لرقمين بعد العلامة العشرية، فـ 5432.6789 تصبح 5432.68.

questions.question: A query writer tries to use CONCAT to count rows. What is the problem?

options.text: CONCAT is a string function for combining text; COUNT is the aggregate function for counting rows.
Both functions always perform the same task.

explanation.ar: دي troubleshooting بين function categories: CONCAT للنصوص، COUNT للعدّ على rows.

questions.question: A stored procedure is created to return employees by department, but the query ignores @DepartmentID and has no WHERE condition. What is the likely result?

options.text: The parameter automatically filters rows even if unused.
The parameter has no filtering effect, so the query can return employees from all departments.

explanation.ar: الـ parameter لازم يدخل فعليًا في query. لو ما استخدمتوش في WHERE، مش هيحصل filtering تلقائي.

source.reference: Slide 26 — How to Use This Procedure

questions.question: Which design is best when a query simply needs an uppercase version of a name for display?

options.text: Use UPPER(name) in the SELECT output.
Create a stored procedure that drops the table.

explanation.ar: لـ display formatting بسيط، UPPER() مباشرة في SELECT هو الاختيار المناسب حسب مثال Scalar Functions.

questions.question: Which design is best for exposing a reusable sales-dashboard result that already includes cleaned names, aggregates, CASE categories, and date calculations?

options.text: Duplicate the source tables for every dashboard refresh.
Create a reporting view whose SELECT contains the taught functions and CASE logic.
Use DROP VIEW after each SELECT.
Avoid SQL functions and calculate nothing.

explanation.ar: ده يجمع الـ Lab والـ Assignment: View reusable للتقرير، وداخله aggregate/string/date functions وCASE حسب المطلوب.

questions.question: A procedure accepts @DepartmentID but a caller passes 101 while the query hard-codes WHERE DepartmentID = 200. What is the main defect?

options.text: The procedure will return both departments because parameters are additive.
The procedure ignores the supplied parameter for filtering and will use the hard-coded department instead.
The parameter converts 200 into a view name.

explanation.ar: المشكلة إن query مش مرتبطة بالـ parameter؛ hard-coded 200 هي اللي تتحكم في النتيجة، فالقيمة 101 ملهاش تأثير.

questions.question: A procedure is intended to raise salary by 10% only when rating = 1 and by 5% otherwise. Which implementation decision best matches the shown UPDATE_SAL logic?

options.text: Remove empNum from the WHERE clause.
Convert salary to text before multiplication.
Use mutually exclusive conditions so only the appropriate UPDATE branch affects the employee.

explanation.ar: الهدف إن branch واحدة بس تتطبق حسب rating؛ لازم الشروط تبقى mutually exclusive ومعها employee filter عشان ما يحصلش تحديث غير مقصود.

questions.question: Suppose an employee salary is 5000 and UPDATE_SAL applies salary = salary * 1.10 for rating = 1. What is the new salary?

explanation.ar: 5000 × 1.10 = 5500، وده tracing مباشر لمنطق زيادة 10% الظاهر في الـ procedure.

questions.question: Suppose an employee salary is 8000 and the second UPDATE_SAL branch applies salary = salary * 1.05. What is the new salary?
A reporting query needs both the original RESCUEDATE and the date three days later. Which expression from the taught material should be added as a derived output?

explanation.ar: DATE_ADD هو التعبير المستخدم في Slide 21 لإضافة 3 أيام على التاريخ.

questions.question: A query uses DAY(RESCUEDATE) expecting it to return the full YYYY-MM-DD date. What is wrong?

options.text: DAY() counts rows instead of dates.
DAY() extracts the day portion, not the full date.

explanation.ar: مثال Slide 20 يوضح إن DAY() تستخرج day portion فقط، زي 29 أو 11، مش التاريخ الكامل.

questions.question: A sales dashboard needs one reusable object that hides raw complexity, returns total orders and total amount, formats customer names, categorizes performance, and calculates tenure. Which combination most directly follows the Session 9 assignment?

options.text: A view whose SELECT combines aggregates, string/date functions, and CASE logic.
A view containing only DROP statements.
A stored procedure that never returns a result.
An index used as the dashboard output table.

explanation.ar: ده نفس تكامل Assignment: View + aggregate functions + formatting functions + CASE + date calculations.

questions.question: Why is SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders; an aggregate query even though it returns only one value?

options.text: Because COUNT is a string function.
Because it computes that single result from multiple input rows.
Because every one-row result is a scalar function.
Because orders must contain exactly one row.

explanation.ar: الـ Aggregate Function ممكن ترجع قيمة واحدة لكنها بتحسبها من multiple rows؛ ده بالضبط تعريف aggregate في Slide 12.

questions.question: A developer sends the full SQL body of a repeated process from the client every time, despite already having a stored procedure for it. Which benefit is being underused?

options.text: The ability of views to store independent data.
The ability of COUNT to uppercase text.
Reduction in network traffic and code reuse.
The ability of DROP VIEW to calculate dates.

explanation.ar: لو كل مرة بنرسل كل statements بدل calling procedure، بنفقد جزء من فائدة code reuse وتقليل network traffic المذكورة في Slide 24.

questions.question: A query needs to present a customer's full name and a rounded average purchase value in the same result. Which combination stays within the taught Session 9 functions?

options.text: COUNT(...) for the name and UPPER(...) for the numeric average.
DATE_ADD(...) for the name and DROP VIEW for the average.
EXEC for the name and CREATE VIEW for the numeric rounding.
CONCAT(...) for the name and ROUND(AVG(...), 2) for the average.

explanation.ar: CONCAT مخصص لتجميع النصوص، وROUND(AVG(...),2) هو نفس pattern المستخدم لتقريب المتوسط.
